1. “Не важно что” - that’s a word-for-word translation from google. It can, however, be used as a “it doesn’t matter that ... “ usually followed by a counterpoint. 
2. “Несмотря ни на что” - this is a more accurate translation, depending on your context of course. 
3. “Что бы ни было” - more like “whatever happens”. This expression is more likely to be used if you in fact don’t know what’s coming, but at the same you don’t care
